metaTitle: How to Stay Cool Camping Without AC
description: Stay cool camping without air conditioning by choosing shade, venting your tent, running a battery fan and cooling your body, with fan power and runtime tips.
directAnswer: Choose a shaded, breezy or higher-elevation site, shade and vent the tent, run a 3 to 6 W battery fan aimed at your body, and cool yourself with water, light clothing and wet towels. Stack several small measures for the best effect.
